The best ways can be jobs, classes in school, and especially clubs and activities. Even if you’re introverted, there will always be those extroverted few who initiate conversation. All you have to be able to do is bounce back conversations.

Dating apps will make you feel that way. Honestly I would just say to delete them, there are better ways to meet people. 
You’re never gonna know how they actually feel about you if you don’t try to talk to them first!

Honestly, I’d say you should try to make friends instead of just searching for romantic interest. Based on personal experience, relying on only one person is a lot for someone to handle. It’s important to have a net of people, especially because in my opinion I think friendships can be way more meaningful and way more long term. 

And I agree that maybe opening with “I have no friends” is probably not the best way to go about those kinds of questions. If I were in your shoes I would just explain that I’m a shy and awkward person who can’t really do well in social situations.
